existing_job.container_source: copy image, roles, environment, secrets, network and logging from the deployed gateway task definition

checkpoint.overlap_policy: one active lease per agent and index, acquired by etag CAS before the repair engine

execute_budget.actual_new_embedding_texts: dry-run fetched count after exact OpenSearch existence checks
execute_budget.approval_gate: review one durable dry run before the first manual execute

activation_order: register an image-pinned task definition revision with the preflight command
run preflight and require ready true with exit code zero
run the durable dry run, verify fetched is at most 25, and retain the prior durable checkpoint
register the execute command only after reviewing dry-run counts and the maximum 25 new embedding texts
keep the schedule disabled until one bounded execute pass and its persisted checkpoint are verified
